news.analysis: This performance was certainly below the norm for Allen, but considering it came against arguably the league's top defense, it was serviceable. Allen eclipsed 2,000 yards passing for the season in this one, and he's now up to a dozen touchdown passes along with a whopping nine rushing scores. Allen remains one of the top fantasy assets in the league regardless of position. He should be set for a larger output against the Jets in Week 10.
news.contents: Josh Allen completed 21 of 31 passes for 234 yards with one touchdown and one interception, adding 15 yards on six carries in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.title: Josh Allen turns in decent performance Monday night

Williams will be a boom/bust flex option in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.
